text: うみの　ポケモンは　ふかい　ところに　いるから　つりざおで　つり　あげるんだ！

structure.jp: うみの　ポケモンは
ふかい　ところに　いるから
つりざおで　つり　あげるんだ！
structure.en: you fish them up with a fishing rod!

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a verb means 'because' or 'so'; the reason comes first. ふかい　ところに　いるから = 'because they live in deep places'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows the tool you use to do something. つりざおで = 'with a fishing rod'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ; it gives the sentence an explaining tone, 'that's how it is'. つり　あげるんだ = 'you fish them up, you see'.
